## Description

Break-glass: temporary read with typed justification, banner, short expiry, post-hoc review queue; audit explorer with filters (actor, patient ref, action, purpose); repeated break-glass alerts the privacy officer.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Break-glass requires justification, expires automatically and appears as "Pending review".
- [ ] **AC2.** Reviewers record outcomes; repeated use triggers an alert.
- [ ] **AC3.** Audit explorer shows opaque patient refs; no PHI in logs.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
